title: Cofinality of coherent vertices of a directed cover by simplicial cones
statement: Use the universes, simplicial sets, quasicategories, ordinary nerves, coherent cocones and colimits of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. For a simplicial set $L$, its right cone $L^{\triangleright}=L\star\Delta^0$ consists of the simplices of $L$, the simplices at a new vertex, and the ordered concatenations of a simplex of $L$ with simplices at that new vertex. Let $K$ be a small quasicategory, let $A$ be a small nonempty partially ordered set in which every finite subset has an upper bound, and let $(K_a)_{a\in A}$ be simplicial subsets with $K_a\subseteq K_b$ for $a\leq b$ and $K=\bigcup_a K_a$. Suppose each $K_a$ is equipped with a simplicial isomorphism $L_a^{\triangleright}\cong K_a$ for some small simplicial set $L_a$; denote its cone vertex by $t_a$. The subsets $K_a$ need not be quasicategories. There exists a simplicial map $j:N(A)\to K$ with $j(a)=t_a$ such that $j$ is cofinal in the following explicit sense: for every quasicategory $\mathcal E$, coherent diagram $H:K\to\mathcal E$ and coherent cocone on $H$, that cocone is colimiting if and only if its restriction along $j$ is colimiting. The comparison uses the same cocone vertex and the restricted legs, and is natural in $H$. No existence of all small colimits in $K$ or $\mathcal E$ is assumed.
